text:
Scale: the plate is roughly 450 px across in the image, and I'm treating it as a dinner plate of about 26 cm, so about 17 px per cm.

Salmon fillet: about 150 px by 140 px, or roughly 9 x 6 cm. Its thickness is about 2.5 cm, so it weighs about 120 g.

Zucchini slices: about 14 half-moon slices, each around 5 cm across and 0.7 cm thick. That is roughly 8 g each, so about 110 g in total.

Yellow squash: about 5 pieces, which I estimate at 60 g.

No separate oil or sauce is clearly visible, so I've left it out; the herbs on the salmon are negligible.
